meta.name: sbti-skill
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "跑一下 SBTI 测试", "做 SBTI 人格测评", "score SBTI answers", "analyze this persona with SBTI", "看看 Claude 自己是什么 SBTI", "answer the SBTI questionnaire", or needs to use the bundled `sbti.md` questionnaire and `sbti_skill.py` scorer in this directory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 SBTI 人格测评并获取分析结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行 SBTI 人格类型测试并解读结果。
copy.tagline_en: Complete the SBTI personality assessment and get analysis results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to take the SBTI personality test and interpret the results.

howto.what: Claude 会读取 SBTI 问卷，根据你的要求（指定角色、自己作答或直接给答案）生成答案 JSON，然后运行评分脚本，输出最终类型、前三候选和维度总结，并给出简短解释。
howto.when: 当你提到“跑一下 SBTI 测试”、“做 SBTI 人格测评”、“score SBTI answers”、“analyze this persona with SBTI”、“看看 Claude 自己是什么 SBTI”、“answer the SBTI questionnaire”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 跑一下 SBTI 测试，测测我的性格类型。
say.note: Claude 会按你的默认风格作答并评分。

say.text: 用 SBTI 分析一下这个角色：一个冷静理性的科学家。
say.note: Claude 会按指定 persona 作答并评分。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the SBTI questionnaire, generates answer JSON based on your request (specified persona, self-answer, or direct answers), runs the scoring script, and outputs the final type, top 3 candidates, dimension summaries, and a brief explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "run SBTI test", "do SBTI personality assessment", "score SBTI answers", "analyze this persona with SBTI", "see what SBTI Claude is", or "answer the SBTI questionnaire".

say_en.text: Run the SBTI test and find out my personality type.
say_en.note: Claude will answer based on your default style and score.

say_en.text: Analyze this persona with SBTI: a calm, rational scientist.
say_en.note: Claude will answer as the specified persona and score.

say_en.text: Here are my SBTI answers: {"q1":"A","q2":"B",...}. Please score them.
say_en.note: Claude will directly score and output results.
